topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Solv Protocol. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 2 contract row(s) across arbitrum, avalanche, base, bob, bsc, ethereum, linea, mantle, merlin, scroll. Structural roles: 1 core, 1 infra. 2 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
